messages:
maya (product): heads-up — jordan from acme asked for a console view that ties trace spans to cost lines. wants per-tenant explainability for spikes. filing here so we can triage.
jordan (sales): yep — they saw a 3x spike last week. need to know whether it was model choice vs routing vs a noisy tenant. they want an "explain" button in the UI that surfaces contributing inputs + per-token charge breakdown.
sam (eng): can we clarify: do they need full trace -> charge mapping (every span tagged with cost attribution) or an aggregated rollup per request id? big perf diff.
jordan (sales): ideal is per-request detail view, but aggregated summary for dashboards is acceptable for launch. priority is to unblock their audit.
lee (data): dependency: we need request ids propagated through the serving runtime and billing pipeline. we have request_id in headers but not consistently preserved in async batch paths. also need a mapping table: request_id -> batch_key -> token_count.
maya (product): suggested MVP scope: (1) UI: per-tenant cost panel with top contributors, (2) backend: guarantee request_id propagation for sync paths + best-effort for batched async, (3) link traces to billing rows with 1:many mapping and indicate uncertainty. launch criteria: reproducible mapping for >95% sync traffic, UX shows uncertainty badges, doc for caveats.
sam (eng): engineering notes: approx 3 days to add tracing hooks + request_id propagation to fp32/quantized paths, 4 days to add a join in billing pipeline to emit trace->cost rows (SQL job). frontend ~2 days for panel + drilldown. opt: slot into sprint 21 or do a focused 1-week ship if we cut aggregations.
maya (product): customer asked for ETA this week. options: (A) Quick triage build (frontend + basic join) — 2 wks scope, (B) Full per-request fidelity — 4+ wks. which do we prefer?
lee (data): cost table sketch (pseudo-SQL):
```
SELECT r.request_id, r.tenant_id, SUM(b.token_count * model_price_per_token) AS cost, ARRAY_AGG(span_id) AS traces
FROM request_meta r
JOIN billing_events b ON b.request_batch = r.batch_key
GROUP BY r.request_id, r.tenant_id;
```
will need to enrich with uncertainty score when batch attribution ambiguous.
jordan (sales): acme leans A if we can commit to short ETA and clear caveats. they can accept aggregated view for now.
sam (eng): note: streaming prefix cache makes attribution slightly hairy for cached tokens — will add a flag `cache_hits` in the join.
ops-bot: jira REDWOOD-4823 created by maya: "Per-tenant telemetry explainability — trace to billing drilldown" (link: https://jira.internal/browse/REDWOOD-4823)
maya (product): next steps: sam to scope exact PRs and blockers by EOD, lee to draft mapping SQL and uncertainty schema, jordan to confirm customer acceptance for option A. will reconvene Fri. :calendar: :rocket:
